comment: Single source of truth for the observability + quality tier (Phase K.4, 2026-05-23; SonarQube moved to Dell 2026-06-05). 'services' are checked on the active (Windows) Docker context by .githooks/check-observability-stack.py and the backend/apps/observability/management/commands/check_observability_health.py session-start ritual. SonarQube and sonar-autoscan run on Dell; Pyroscope remains on Mint. The pre-commit hook verifies remote HTTP services over the network via their health_url. The dedicated Sonar verifier is scripts/check-dell-sonar-tools.ps1; the Mint verifier remains scripts/check-mint-quality-tools.ps1 for Mint-owned quality/profiling services. glitchtip-init is intentionally excluded because it is an init job that exits after running. See docs/specs/fr-observability-always-on-and-no-deferral.md.
